meta.title: DSH work process 3D live view
meta.description: Adds a "3D process" tab to the view tabs of every conversation. It shows the conversation's work as a 3D precision factory in a skyscraper atrium: a fuel tank for your DeepSeek balance, an engine and console for the generation rate, context pressure and token counters, ten tool stations that process a wafer for each tool call and show their status and latest outcomes on holographic readouts, a subagent dock whose drones carry out subagent and workflow tasks, a stocker that stores each turn as a batch, and big curved screens you can look at up close. The data comes from the plugin's Host session projection, so restart DSH once after installing or updating; Display also offers a demo session. Orbit and roam camera modes and views such as Overview, Fuel, Engine, Stations, Dock, Products, Living and Balcony are included. It needs WebGL 2 with hardware acceleration; quality starts from your GPU and drops automatically when the frame rate is low.
